munaza-khattak.name: Munaza Khattak
qualifications: BDS, Khyber College of Dentistry, Peshawar (1988-1992)
Master of Public Health, University of Peshawar (2008-2010)
experience: Dental Surgeon, Health Department KPK, Peshawar and Karak (1992-1995)
Lecturer, Physiology Department, Jinnah Medical College, Warsak Road, Peshawar (2011-2012)
Senior Lecturer, Physiology Department, Frontier Medical College, Abbottabad (June 2013 – November 2013)
Lecturer, Physiology Department, Kohat Institute of Medical Sciences (March 2014 – August 2014)
Assistant Professor, Physiology Department, Peshawar Medical College (2014-2020)
Associate Professor, Physiology Department, Peshawar Medical College (2020-2024)
Professor, Physiology Department, Peshawar Medical College (2024 – Till date)
